inputs.text: [excited] Uh… MAR… guh… SOR… us. [curious] This name comes from a place! "La Amarga," in Argentina, where its bones were found.
[happily] Right. It lived in Argentina, a hundred twenty-five million years ago.
[curious] Did it have anything special about it?
[serious] Two rows of really big spikes, [amazed] running down its neck and its back.
